records.issue_text: app/models/embeddable_host.rb:3 — host format regex requires a TLD of `[a-z]{2,5}`, rejecting valid newer long TLDs like .technology, .international, and .museum, and also rejects IP-address hosts, preventing admins from adding legitimate hosts
records.rationale: The new model `app/models/embeddable_host.rb` adds `validates_format_of :host` with `/\.[a-z]{2,5}/` (line 3), which will indeed reject valid longer TLDs (e.g. `.technology`, `.international`, `.museum`) and does not match IP-literal hosts. Since this validation gates what admins can save as an EmbeddableHost, it can prevent legitimate hosts from being added.
